selection.rule: Keep original validation16; take first240 SHA256(namespace/uid), then UID, from the continuous development pool after exclusions. No labels or model outcomes select users.
selection.pool_scope: Existing retrospective development pool includes outcome-conditioned Motivation users. This new sampling is label-free within that pool, not a population confirmation sample.

fit_expansion.rule: Keep fit256 and validation256; add the previously inspected SHA256(namespace/uid) first768 from the remaining excluded pool. No redraw, labels, outcomes, or request cap select users.

window_rule: Uniform28 days for every release, decided from original fixed256/16 pre-release label coverage before expansion:14-day v4 validation was single-class. Expansion uses only UID hashing and exclusions; all real requests in the chosen windows are retained.
causality: Every row satisfies target_cutover-28days <= query_timestamp < target_cutover.
Use searchsorted(timestamp, side='left'): all history at the query timestamp is excluded, including other same-timestamp events.
Extended history supports historical queries from D231. The actual continuous V2 trajectory must initialize from canonical_* at D259; do not replace that seed with an extended-history tail.
History after a target's cutover is input availability for later targets only, never permission to use future events.
Requests may repeat across overlapping target windows; (target,request_id) is the training-row identity.
Labels are retained real feedback on known mapped items; no sampled catalog item is assigned a negative label.
No evaluation user requests or labels enter this output; this is a development calibration set, not a fresh population confirmation.

capture_memory_estimate.convention: FP32 native K/V plus six-layer Item64 code; each UID/timestamp shared among its requests. No new teacher cache. Excludes tensor-object/allocator overhead, models, staging batches and input packs; not measured process RSS.
